query: MATCH (canonical:Paper {paper_key: '5J5XDKMN'}), (legacy:Paper {paper_key: 'zotero:SZJE69PE'}) WHERE canonical.arxiv_id = '1709.04891' AND legacy.arxiv_id = '1709.04891' CALL { WITH canonical, legacy MATCH (legacy)-[:ABOUT]->(n) MERGE (canonical)-[:ABOUT]->(n) RETURN count(n) AS about_moved } CALL { WITH canonical, legacy MATCH (legacy)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(n) MERGE (canonical)-[:AUTHORED_BY]->(n) RETURN count(n) AS authors_moved } CALL { WITH canonical, legacy MATCH (legacy)-[:HAS_TAG]->(n) MERGE (canonical)-[:HAS_TAG]->(n) RETURN count(n) AS tags_moved } CALL { WITH canonical, legacy MATCH (legacy)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(n) MERGE (canonical)-[:IN_COLLECTION]->(n) RETURN count(n) AS collections_moved } CALL { WITH canonical, legacy MATCH (legacy)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(n:PaperChunk) SET n.paper_key = canonical.paper_key MERGE (canonical)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(n) RETURN count(n) AS chunks_moved } SET canonical.author = coalesce(canonical.author, legacy.author), canonical.doi = coalesce(nullIf(canonical.doi, ''), legacy.doi), canonical.source = 'zotero' DETACH DELETE legacy RETURN canonical.paper_key AS canonical_key, canonical.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, canonical.doi AS doi, about_moved, authors_moved, tags_moved, collections_moved, chunks_moved
